name: shiksha-answer-depth-tutorial
title: Choose the right answer depth

chapters.caption: 01  Open your course and choose how much explanation you want.
02  Concise gives a short response to a focused question.
03  Switch to Comprehensive when you want a worked explanation.
04  Read the example and its assumptions; depth can change on every turn.

description: Compare Concise and Comprehensive using the real answer-depth selector and streamed responses.
capture: Actual unchanged React frontend; scripted interactions, synthetic course data and in-memory API responses.
timing: Captured frames are paced for readability, not a performance benchmark.
isolation: Fresh browser context. External services blocked; all API calls simulated. No remote course creation.
